from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FairValueChangeIncome(BaseModel):
    """Fair value change income reported in one company's financial report for a specific period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name in the report")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code if provided")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The fair value change income amount; negative for losses")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元', 'yuan'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the metric name and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fair_value_change_incomes: list[FairValueChangeIncome]
